nodes.label: AI Differentiation Roadmap — 'the teacher is the product, the dataset is the moat'
Build A: migrate /api/explain teacher from hardcoded gpt-4o-mini to Claude Haiku 4.5 with streaming + prompt caching (3-4 days)
nodes.rationale: Pedagogical quality on plain-English explanation is the product; prompt caching collapses per-call cost for a chatty copilot; the source:'mock' fallback at route.ts:52-53 must be preserved exactly.

nodes.label: Build C: stateful proactive copilot v1 — post-trade critique on Sonnet, gated at Pro $39, instrumented against the 24h North-Star metric
nodes.rationale: A competitor can bolt 'AI explains this trade' onto a visualizer in weeks but cannot bolt on memory of a user's past confusion, because it doesn't own the decision traces — copilot quality is a function of the flywheel and the flywheel compounds.

nodes.label: Build B: decision-trace logging into MongoDB with schema_version, DPDP-consented anonymized capture, and a written confusion heuristic
nodes.rationale: The dataset's value is cumulative and India's free funnel makes it large — logging must start day one; an un-consented dataset is an un-sellable dataset under DPDP Act 2023, and 'detect confusion' is not implementable until thresholds are written down.

nodes.label: Build E: confusion-resolution fine-tune of Haiku on (confusion → resolving explanation → paper trade) tuples, Power $59 gate, Phase 3
nodes.rationale: Fine-tuning needs on the order of 1,000+ clean confusion-resolution tuples to beat few-shot prompting; below that volume E becomes a better few-shot prompt library, not a fine-tune — do not promise it until Build B confirms feasibility.

nodes.label: Build D: natural-language-to-strategy on Opus, emitting a draggable Bet Builder canvas (table stakes, conversion accelerant, cut before C)
nodes.rationale: Composer, QuantConnect Mia and NexusTrade all have NL-to-strategy — a feature, not a company; ours differs by outputting the visual learning canvas rather than code, and each NL request is a labeled datapoint of how a beginner phrases a thesis.

nodes.label: Ground-truth correction: direction accuracy is banded 55.5% LOW → 60/61/64 → 66% ULTRA, not a flat 56%; consensus votes over 6 models, workbench holds 27 bots total
nodes.rationale: The draft's '27-bot consensus' conflated workbench size (27 = 12 AI + 15 classical) with the 6-model ensemble, and '13 PyTorch surrogates' was wrong — the FastAPI service loads 5 named surrogates plus sequence-CNN/transformer, with an sklearn direction ensemble.

nodes.label: Rent intelligence (Claude API); own the dataset, the tuning, the 5 pricing surrogates and the honest source:'mock' fallback
nodes.rationale: Frontier reasoning is not where 3 people compete; the decision-trace dataset is the only asset an acquirer can't reproduce with a prompt — keep it clean, consented, exportable, diligence-legible; the 55.5-66% ensemble is framed as pedagogy, never an oracle.
